# Graphite

> > Graphite is an AI-powered code review platform for GitHub that introduces stacked PRs, merge queues, and automated code review through the Graphite CLI and Diamond AI agent.

Graphite streamlines developer workflows with tools like the gt CLI for managing stacked diffs, PR inbox management, and AI-assisted code reviews. The platform integrates with GitHub, VS Code, Slack, and other developer tools, serving companies like Ramp, Shopify, and Snowflake. Graphite was acquired by Cursor to build unified development tools.

## Key Topics

- Stacked PRs and stacked diffs
- AI code review (Diamond agent)
- Graphite CLI (gt commands)
- GitHub integration
- Merge queue
- Pull request workflow
- Developer productivity
- Code review automation
- Git workflow optimization
- CI/CD integration
- GitHub Actions
- Version control best practices
- Developer tools ecosystem
